🎉 Gender Reveal Surprise Affiliate Program

Brand Introduction:
Gender Reveal Surprise is the go-to destination for unforgettable gender reveal moments. We specialize in high-impact, photo-friendly products that turn life’s biggest announcement into a celebration. From confetti cannons to powder extinguishers and smoke bombs, we help families create memories that last a lifetime.

Product Description:
Our product line includes a curated selection of gender reveal essentials designed for visual impact and ease of use. Top sellers include our compressed air confetti cannons, biodegradable powder cannons, colorful smoke bombs, and crowd-favorite gender reveal extinguishers—all available in both pink and blue.

Unique Selling Point (USP):

  • Exclusive products not found in big-box stores

  • Instagram-worthy designs made for capturing the perfect moment

  • Safe, reliable, and easy-to-use items backed by thousands of 5-star reviews

  • Fast, discreet shipping to keep the surprise intact

Payment Terms:

  • Commission Rate: 10% per sale

  • Cookie Duration: 30 days

  • Payout Method: PayPal 

  • Payout Schedule: Monthly, with a $25 minimum balance for withdrawal

Other Information:
We offer full marketing support to our affiliates, including product images, promotional banners, and example captions. High-performing affiliates may receive free products, bonus incentives, and early access to new releases. This is a great opportunity for influencers, party planners, photographers, and family-focused content creators.

GENDER REVEAL SURPRISE AFFILIATE AGREEMENT

As an authorized affiliate of Blaise Pyrotechnics LLC. dba Gender Reveal Surprise (hereinafter referred to as "GRS"), you agree to abide by the terms and conditions contained in this Agreement. Please read the entire Agreement carefully before registering and promoting GRS as an Affiliate.

Your participation in the program is solely to legally promote our website and products to receive a commission on products purchased by individuals referred to GRS by your own website or personal referrals.

By signing up for the GRS Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understand, and agree to comply with the following terms and conditions, and accept legal responsibility for adhering to them.

1. Approval or Rejection of the Application:

GRS reserves the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program Application at its sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against GRS for the rejection of your application.

2. Commissions:

GRS pays a set commission on qualifying sales based on the agreed-upon affiliate offer. Commissions are paid on the last day of each month via PayPal for all confirmed sales made in the previous calendar month.

You will not receive commissions on your own purchases.

GRS reserves the right to reverse or deny commissions due to returns, cancellations, chargebacks, order errors, or other issues that invalidate the original transaction.

3. Referral Tracking:

GRS tracks referred customers using cookies valid for 30 days. Only purchases made while the cookie is active will be counted as referred sales in your affiliate dashboard.

4. Affiliate Links:

You may use GRS-approved graphics and text, or create your own materials provided they are accurate, appropriate, and do not mislead or misrepresent the brand.

5. Coupon and Deal Sites:

Coupons may only be promoted by affiliates who are pre-approved and provided a branded coupon by GRS.

The following rules apply:

  • No misleading link text or button language implying unauthorized deals.

  • No bidding on keywords including “GRS coupons,” “GRS discount,” or similar.

  • No use of pop-ups, iframes, or hidden mechanisms to set affiliate cookies.

  • No false “Click for Coupon” messages if no valid offer exists.

Violations may result in immediate removal from the program.

6. Restrictions on Promotions:

The GRS Affiliate Program is intended for use through genuine content-based marketing or personal recommendations.

The following are strictly prohibited:

  • Paid traffic (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, etc.)

  • Retargeting or display advertising

  • Coupon, rebate, or cashback sites (unless approved)

  • Methods deemed by GRS to be deceptive, spammy, or misaligned with the brand

Violations may lead to denied commissions and possible removal from the program.

7. Termination:

Your status in the program may be suspended or terminated for reasons including, but not limited to:

  • False or misleading advertising

  • Spam tactics (email, forums, social media)

  • Promoting on illegal or inappropriate sites

  • Failing to disclose affiliate status per FTC guidelines

  • Fraudulent or self-referrals

  • Any violation of this agreement or misuse of brand assets

GRS reserves the right to terminate any affiliate account at any time, with or without cause.

8. Liability:

GRS is not liable for indirect damages such as loss of revenue or data due to tracking errors, system failures, or any actions that may impact program performance beyond reasonable control.

9. Term and Modification:

This agreement begins upon your acceptance and continues until your affiliate account is terminated.

GRS may update or change these terms at any time. Continued participation in the program after such changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms. If you disagree with any updates, your sole option is to terminate your affiliate relationship.
